__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Existing Prometheus datasource
__inputs.description: Select the existing Prometheus datasource that scrapes the CWO exporter.

description: CWO-associated Codex sessions and agents, optional workflow audit events, and separately observed app-server dispatches. Whole-session usage remains distinct from CWO-only cost.

panels.title: Sessions with CWO
panels.description: Sessions with a structured CWO skill block or supported CWO helper command, and activity in the selected range.

targets.expr: count(max by (project_id, session_id) ((cwo_codex_session_info{kind="session"} and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Associated agents
panels.description: Subagent sessions associated directly or through a CWO-associated parent before their creation, with activity in the selected range.

targets.expr: count(max by (project_id, session_id) ((cwo_codex_session_info{kind="subagent"} and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Recorded session tokens
panels.description: Whole-session recorded token totals for the selected CWO-associated sessions and agents. Includes earlier session history; this is not CWO-exclusive cost. Missing or conflicting usage is omitted, so the total can be a lower bound.

targets.expr: sum((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{token_kind="total"}) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state) == 1))

panels.title: CWO helper commands
panels.description: Recorded completed command items invoking a supported CWO helper within the selected range. Includes failed attempts; separate from model jobs and audit preparations.

targets.expr: count((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: CWO-associated session activity
panels.description: Whole-profile session activity. Project and Task selectors below the dashboard title apply only to the observed-dispatch sections. Token values are whole-session recorded totals.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_join((max by (project_id, session_id, kind, model, effort) (cwo_codex_session_info) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))), "model_effort", " / ", "model", "effort"), "project", "$1", "project_id", "(.+)")

(max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info)))

(max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{token_kind="total"}) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state) == 1)

1000 * (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info)))

panels.title: CWO session source scan
panels.description: Scanned means selected rollout files were read without gaps. It does not prove that every use of the CWO skill produced a recognizable signal.

panels.title: CWO files pending
panels.description: Files awaiting CWO history scanning. Counts are lower bounds during backfill.

panels.title: CWO source gaps
panels.description: Malformed or oversized candidate records, conflicting observations, or source access failures.

panels.title: CWO scan age
panels.description: Age of the latest CWO session-source scan.

options.content:
**CWO association** comes from an explicit skill block, a supported helper command, or a parent session. These views cover the selected Codex profile across projects. Tokens cover whole sessions, including earlier history, rather than CWO-only cost.

Token scale: K = thousand · Mil = million · Bil = billion · Tri = trillion. Exact counts are in the detail tables. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch sections.

panels.title: Workflow activity · all configured audit logs
Workflow events
panels.description: Unique recorded CWO audit events whose source timestamps fall in the selected range. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch sections below.

targets.expr: count(((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_audit_collection_complete[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Packets built
panels.description: Contractor packets prepared. This counts preparation, not executed jobs. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch sections below.

targets.expr: count(((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="packet_built"}[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="packet_built"}[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_audit_collection_complete[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Dispatches prepared
panels.description: Recorded dispatch preparations. A preparation does not establish that the job ran. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch sections below.

targets.expr: count(((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="dispatch_prepared"}[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="dispatch_prepared"}[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_audit_collection_complete[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Reviews evaluated
panels.description: Recorded review evaluations, including reevaluations. This is an event count, not unique completed jobs. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch sections below.

targets.expr: count(((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="return_evaluated"}[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds{event_type="return_evaluated"}[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_audit_collection_complete[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Workflow events by type
panels.description: Unique source-time events by type across all configured audit logs.

targets.expr: count by (event_type) (((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000))))

panels.title: Selected audit files
panels.description: Read successfully means configured audit files were read within their limits. This is not a check of all CWO sessions.

panels.title: Audit scan age
panels.description: Age of the latest audit scan attempt. Source access errors are reported separately.

panels.title: Audit source errors
panels.description: File or directory access failures in the latest scan.

panels.title: Skipped audit records
panels.description: Records omitted from the latest scan. Query cwo_audit_skipped_records by reason for details.

options.content: **Workflow activity** counts source-time events from all configured audit logs. Project and Task selectors apply only to the observed-dispatch panels below. Export: newest 2,000 events within 30 days. Partial coverage means counts may be incomplete.

panels.title: Agents working
panels.description: Active workers in the selected work. Zero means observed work has finished; missing history stays unavailable.

targets.expr: count(count by (project_id, agent_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) <= 2))) or (0 * count(last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Stopped or failed
panels.description: Stopped, failed or disconnected tasks in the selected history. These are outcomes, not necessarily unresolved problems.

panels.title: Tokens reported
panels.description: Sum of reported total usage. Missing usage is excluded and remains visible in the work table. This is not a billing estimate.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Observed agent activity
panels.description: Freshly observed agents whose task state is starting or running. Each point requires a sample within 20 seconds. Retired tasks and missing observations leave gaps. This is recorded activity, not model compute time; short bursts may be missed at coarse time ranges.

targets.expr: count(count by (project_id, agent_id) (max by (project_id, dispatch_id, agent_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[20s])) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[20s])) <= 2))) or (0 * count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id, agent_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[20s]))))

panels.title: Task outcomes
panels.description: One outcome per observed task run. Stopped / failed includes interruptions, failures and lost control. In progress counts task runs, whereas the agent card deduplicates workers. Unknown remains a separate category. Only outcomes present in the selected history are shown.

targets.expr: (count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) == 3) or (0 * count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))))) > 0

(count((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) == 4) or (max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) == 5) or (max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) == 6)) or (0 * count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))))) > 0

(count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) <= 2) or (0 * count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))))) > 0

(count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])) == 7) or (0 * count(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))))) > 0

panels.title: Work and results
panels.description: One row per task run. Names are supplied by the task launcher. Model and effort are the selected settings. Click a task to focus the dashboard; expand Technical details for identity and accounting evidence.

targets.expr: max by (dispatch_id) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Input tokens reported
panels.description: Sum of reported input token usage for the selected tasks. Partial values are included and missing values excluded; these are reported contributions, not a complete-usage guarantee. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additional totals.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="input"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="input"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="input"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="input"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Output tokens reported
panels.description: Sum of reported output token usage for the selected tasks. Partial values are included and missing values excluded; these are reported contributions, not a complete-usage guarantee. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additional totals.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="output"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="output"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="output"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="output"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Completed model responses
panels.description: Observed completed model responses, including responses in tasks that later stopped or failed. This is not the number of upstream requests or retry attempts. Accounting conflicts are excluded. After a known source gap, this can be a lower bound.

targets.expr: sum(max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_completed_cycles_total{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3)))

panels.title: Where tokens went
panels.description: Reported token usage by task. Tasks without usage are excluded from this comparison and marked Not reported in the work table.

targets.expr: max by (dispatch_id) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Time spent by task
panels.description: Elapsed task time from the controller clock. This is wall time, not model compute time or an estimate of time remaining.

options.content:
**Observed-dispatch coverage:** Jobs recorded by the observation hook or observed-job runner. Other CWO-associated sessions appear in the section above.

Model and effort are selected settings. Missing usage stays missing. Elapsed is wall time, not an ETA.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Live scrape freshness and ledger health. Finished tasks do not need an active model connection.

panels.title: Technical details · identities, coverage and accounting
Active distinct agents
panels.description: Distinct agent instances whose latest selected-range lifecycle state is submitted, acknowledged, or running. Shows zero when all observed agents are terminal; no agent history remains unavailable.

panels.title: Terminal dispatches in selected range
panels.description: Dispatch identities whose latest selected-range state is terminal. This is dispatch history, not an agent count.

panels.title: Publication backlog
panels.description: Terminal dispatches still awaiting exact-series publication confirmation.

panels.title: Collector freshness
panels.description: Seconds since the latest accepted local telemetry event. This is observation freshness, not provider latency.

panels.title: Requested dispatch configuration
panels.description: Immutable request metadata. Requested configuration is not per-response attribution.

panels.title: Acknowledged configured model and effort
panels.description: Configured model and effort remain independent observations. Neither identifies what served an individual response.

panels.title: Completed cycles and coverage
panels.description: Observed unique completions remain visible with their latest coverage state. Accounting conflicts suppress the numeric total.

panels.title: Observed token totals with provenance
panels.description: Only present, runtime-normalized, or partial latest values render. State 2 means upstream presence is unknown for optional subsets, including nonzero values. Coverage conflict suppresses numeric totals.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3)

panels.title: Cycle detail and observed order
panels.description: Cycle ordinal is first accepted bound observation order. Timestamp is local observation time, not response duration or provider compute time.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(cwo_cycle_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, cycle_ordinal, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_cycle_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_cycle_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 2))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3)

panels.title: Cycle allowance and enforced tool ceiling
panels.description: Declared completed-cycle allowance and derived use are display-only. The enforced tool-call ceiling is a separate authoritative unit.

targets.expr: last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_cycle_remaining{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_cycle_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1)

last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_cycle_overrun{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_cycle_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1)

panels.title: Elapsed allowance and enforced runtime ceiling
panels.description: Elapsed values require qualified supervisor timing. Declared elapsed allowance and enforced runtime ceiling remain separate.

targets.expr: last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_elapsed_remaining_seconds{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_elapsed_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="dispatch_elapsed"}[$__range]) == 1)

last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_elapsed_overrun_seconds{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_elapsed_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="dispatch_elapsed"}[$__range]) == 1)

panels.title: Dispatch state and field availability
panels.description: Latest lifecycle, coverage, and field-state codes make unavailable, partial, unqualified, clock-gap, and overflow values explicit.

panels.title: Observed outcomes and bounded tool activity
panels.description: Retry notices and turn outcomes are observations, not exact request attempts. Tool categories have no response association.

panels.title: Telemetry components and publication state
panels.description: Each component exposes one active bounded state. Publication health is independent of collection and dispatch coverage.

panels.title: Telemetry event dispositions
panels.description: Collector event dispositions. These counters are not provider request counts.

title: CWO Dispatches
